integrity: The fourth-power identities are proved by two exact coefficient-squaring transforms, and fundamentality is proved from exact field discriminants plus a strict Artin-inequality contradiction. The included verifier uses only integer arithmetic.
scientific_limitations: Only the parameters \(b=5\) and \(b=96\) are classified here; no global classification of fourth-power square-exceptions is asserted.
The proof imports the published prime-by-prime index formulas and Artin discriminant inequality, while replaying every parameter-specific substitution exactly.
title: Two additional exact fourth-power exceptions in a cubic-unit family
